title: Domain
description: Show that the website is yours: add a DNS record to its domain, and the product page says the domain is verified.
noDomain: Your website's address is not on a domain of its own, such as an IP address, so there is nowhere to add the record. Use an address on your own domain to verify it.
missing: The record was not found on <date></date>. The domain stays verified for three days after that; add the record back before then.
instructions: Add this TXT record where you manage DNS for {domain}, then check it. Keep the record in place: it is checked again every day, and a record missing for three days removes the mark. Addresses on a hosting service's domain, such as your-app.vercel.app, cannot take records of their own.
name: Name
nameHint: Enter {label} as the name: your DNS provider adds .{domain} itself. If it asks for the full name, enter {name}.

result.notOwner: You can only verify the domain of your own SaaS.
result.loadFailed: The SaaS could not be loaded. Please try again.
result.noDomain: Your website's address is not on a domain of its own, so there is nowhere to add the record.
result.failed: The domain could not be checked. Please try again.
result.tooSoon: The domain was checked a moment ago. Try again in a few seconds.
result.tooOften: Domains were checked many times in the last hour. Try again later.
result.verified: {domain} is verified. We check the record again every day.
result.missing: The record was not found at {record}. Check its name and value; new records can take a few minutes to appear.
result.grace: The record was not found at {record}. {domain} stays verified for three days after the record goes missing, so add it back before then.
result.removed: The record has been missing for three days, so {domain} is no longer verified. Add it again to verify the domain.
result.dnsTimeout: DNS did not answer in time. Please try again in a moment.
result.changed: Your website changed during the check. Please try again.
